rows.note: Use this for fabric or material that is very thin and see-through.

example.english: The fabric of this shirt is so sheer that you can see whatever is worn underneath.
example.traditional: 呢件衫嘅布料咁透薄，入面着咩都睇到。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 bou3 liu6 gam3 tau3 bok6 jap6 min6 zoek3 me1 dou1 tai2 dou2

rows.note: Use this to emphasize a notably large amount, size, or degree.

example.english: The sheer length of the two-hour wait was too much for everyone.
example.traditional: 我哋等足足兩個鐘，大家都頂唔順喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dang2 zuk1 zuk1 loeng5 go3 zung1 daai6 gaa1 dou1 ding2 m4 seon6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for something that is complete, utter, or pure in the relevant quality.

example.english: They show sheer confidence when they speak.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢嗰種自信真係十足。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 go2 zung2 zi6 seon3 zan1 hai6 sap6 zuk1

rows.note: Use this for a drop or descent that goes straight down and is almost vertical.

example.english: This mountain path drops sheer to the sea, so be careful.
example.traditional: 呢條山路直落到海邊，小心啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 saan1 lou6 zik6 lok6 dou3 hoi2 bin1 siu2 sam1 di1
